sources_note: Headlines summarised from reporting published 22 Nov 2026.

stories.headline: COP31 talks collapse with no deal at all
stories.summary: Two weeks of climate talks in Antalya ended Sunday with no deal at all, after the EU rejected a final draft that said nothing about fossil fuels or a phase-out.

stories.headline: Russian drone flattens Kyiv apartment block
stories.summary: A Russian drone partly destroyed a five-storey block near Kyiv; at least 14 people were missing as rescuers dug through the rubble.

stories.headline: Iran shows off underground 'missile city'
stories.summary: Iran released footage of a new underground launcher that fires two missiles at once, as Washington weighs renewed strikes on Tehran.

stories.headline: FBI probes hack of national crime database
stories.summary: The FBI is investigating an apparent breach of the National Crime Information Center, used for warrants and criminal records.

stories.headline: Candy factory fire kills 3, dozens missing
stories.summary: A fire at a candy factory in Cikande, Banten, killed at least three workers; dozens were still missing as rescuers searched the ruins.

stories.headline: BepiColombo reaches Mercury after 8 years
stories.summary: Europe and Japan's BepiColombo probe entered orbit around Mercury, ending an eight-year journey to the Solar System's smallest planet.

stories.headline: Mexico captures 'El Chapo Isidro'
stories.summary: Special forces seized cartel boss Fausto Isidro Meza Flores; 11 died in the raid.

stories.headline: Minister quits over exam AI-cheating row
stories.summary: Education chief Choi Kyo-jin quit over CSAT cheating chaos; Lee accepted within the hour.

stories.headline: Funeral boat sinks, 24 dead
stories.summary: A crowded boat to a burial capsized in Bayelsa; 24 died, 24 were rescued.

stories.headline: Sea drones hit Russian warship
stories.summary: Suspected Ukrainian drones badly damaged the corvette Merkury at the base.

subtitle: Ten stories that defined the day — from Antalya to Mercury.
